title: Han's heavy heaving hypertrophic hoisting hustle 2
author: Julián E.

ex.note:
Rep ceiling progression:
Once you hit all 4 sets at 8 reps @ ≤9 RPE THEN increase load

You can either do all of them as dropsets or just the last.

Single hand DB with stick. 2nd weight is 20% lighter than first weight + BW set burnout.
Progression: when you can reach all four sets at 10 reps at the suggested RPE THEN add load.

ss.note: Progression: when you can reach all three sets at 5 reps at the RPE THEN add load.
